steps.title: Break the question down
steps.prompt:
Question: {{inputs.question}}

Save the question word for word in {{run.dir}}/question.md. Write {{run.dir}}/plan.md: six atomic items, the depth each needs, and three search angles per item, each on its own line as search: <query>. Do not search yet.

steps.title: Approve the plan
steps.gate_summary: Read {{run.dir}}/plan.md. Approve to start searching; reject cancels the run.

steps.title: Go deep on one key point
steps.prompt: Plan: {{run.dir}}/plan.md. Sources: {{run.dir}}/sources/. Take key point {{index}} of 0 to 3. Write {{run.dir}}/depth-{{index}}.md: each position with a verbatim quote and its source id, and every source that disagrees. Use only saved sources.

steps.title: Find what would overturn it
steps.prompt: Read {{run.dir}}/depth-*.md and {{run.dir}}/sources/. For each position, name the saved source that would overturn it, or say none does. Write {{run.dir}}/digest.md with the positions, the challenges, and the gaps as limits.

steps.title: Draft the report
steps.prompt: Write {{run.dir}}/report.md from {{run.dir}}/digest.md only, answering {{run.dir}}/question.md. Every claim carries a verbatim quote in double quotes and its source id from {{run.dir}}/sources/sources.json in brackets, like [s01]. Set the output key document to the report path and sources to a list of title and url for each cited source.

steps.title: Critique the report
steps.prompt: Read {{run.dir}}/report.md. You are critic {{index}} of 0 to 2: 0 off-topic, 1 overclaiming, 2 missing evidence. Write {{run.dir}}/critics-{{index}}.json as a list of findings with severity, title and detail. Set the output key findings to that path. Do not edit the report.

steps.title: Patch the report
steps.prompt: Apply the findings in {{run.dir}}/critics-*.json and, if it exists, the failures in {{run.dir}}/cite-check.json to {{run.dir}}/report.md. Edit in place; never regenerate the report.
